 Upcoming Daylight Saving Time Change: What Massac County Needs to Know
 / WMOK 
 WMOK - Metropolis, IL 
 Oct 19, 2026 | 1:33 PM 
 WMOK – Massac County, IL –
 It is almost time to turn back the hands of time, Massac County. Daylight saving time officially ends on Sunday, November 1st, at 2:00 a.m. 
 Before you turn in on Saturday night, October 31st, be sure to set your clocks back one hour. This seasonal shift means gaining an extra hour of sleep over the weekend, though morning commute routines will see earlier light and evenings will get dark earlier. 
 Local emergency services also remind residents that the biannual time change is a great opportunity to test the batteries in your home smoke and carbon monoxide detectors. Stay tuned to WMOK for more local updates and community reminders.
